body:
Implements T-P06 and T-P12 from .adlc/specs/enhancement-resolution-plan.md.

Acceptance criteria:
1. .github/workflows/ticket-store-platform.yml runs npm ci --ignore-scripts instead of bare npm install.
2. packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs classifies all 7 harness plugin enforcement cores, packages/core/, packages/tickets/, packages/hollow-test/, packages/hook-engine/, nested package.json manifests, .adlc/lessons/, .adlc/lenses/, and required CI gate scripts as trust-root tier (verified by packages/prosecute/test/tier-plugin-and-scripts.test.mjs).
3. packages/prosecute/lib/run.mjs requires correctness and security lenses among final dry lenses for p5-complete, rejects symlinked transcript and review_packet artifacts via lstatSync, and binds p5-complete headSha to git rev-parse HEAD when inside a git repo (verified by packages/prosecute/test/mandatory-lenses.test.mjs).
4. packages/parallax/lib/prompts.mjs fences request and question interpolations with @adlc/core fence() and UNTRUSTED_DIRECTIVE (verified by packages/parallax/test/fenced-prompts.test.mjs).
5. packages/spec-lint/lib/llm.mjs and bin/spec-lint.mjs fail closed instead of silently truncating criteria exceeding maxBytes unless --max-bytes is raised (verified by packages/spec-lint/test/truncation-guard.test.mjs).
6. coldstart, premortem, and parallax --prompt-only --record-verdict record failing/blocked verdicts to the manifest and exit 2 (verified by packages/parallax/test/fenced-prompts.test.mjs).
title: Wave 1B Part 1: tier.mjs expansion, ticket-store-platform --ignore-scripts, prosecute mandatory lenses, parallax fencing, spec-lint truncation guard, and record-verdict exit 2
